headword: {携帯番号|けいたいばんごう}
gloss: mobile phone number; cell phone number

definitions.gloss: mobile phone number; cell phone number
definitions.explanation: The telephone number assigned to a mobile phone. A common everyday term in Japan where mobile phones are ubiquitous.

examples.japanese: {携帯番号|けいたいばんごう}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me your mobile phone number.

examples.japanese: {携帯番号|けいたいばんごう}が{変|か}わったので{連絡|れんらく}します。
examples.english: I'm letting you know because my cell phone number has changed.

examples.japanese: {個人情報|こじんじょうほう}なので、{携帯番号|けいたいばんごう}は{他人|たにん}に{教|おし}えないほうがいい。
examples.english: Since it's personal information, you shouldn't give your mobile number to strangers.

notes:
Composed of {携帯|けいたい} (mobile phone, short for {携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}) + {番号|ばんごう} (number). Extremely common in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {携帯番号|けいたいばんごう}を{教|おし}える: to give one's mobile number
- {携帯番号|けいたいばんごう}を{変|か}える: to change one's mobile number
- {携帯番号|けいたいばんごう}を{登録|とうろく}する: to register a mobile number
- {携帯番号|けいたいばんごう}で{認証|にんしょう}する: to verify by mobile number

JAPAN NOTE:
Japanese mobile numbers begin with 070, 080, or 090. Number portability ({番号|ばんごう}ポータビリティ) allows users to keep their number when switching carriers.

RELATED WORDS:
- {携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}: mobile phone — the full form
- {携帯|けいたい}: mobile phone — the common abbreviation
- スマホ: smartphone — the modern abbreviation of スマートフォン
- {電話番号|でんわばんごう}: phone number — the general term including landlines
